the blue gradient as undifferentiated potential

limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; the rectangle could be purely decorative or technical.

alternative_interpretations: The setup reflects standard ergonomic or aesthetic arrangement, with no symbolic intent.
limitations: No human operator is present; the interpretation assumes intentionality not evident in the image alone.
